title: IHAVE envelope msgid vs body msgid mismatch: duplicate check bypassed
description: TRIGGER: A peer sends IHAVE <known-duplicate@example> with article body containing Message-ID: <new-article@example>. BEHAVIOR: check_ingest in transit/src/peering/ingestion.rs deduplicates using the command-line msgid (known-duplicate@example), finds it already known, and returns Reject. Peer then resends IHAVE <different-envelope@example> with the same body. Now the envelope msgid is unknown so check_ingest passes, but run_pipeline in pipeline.rs parses the Message-ID from article bytes (<new-article@example>) and stores that. Result: dedup table has entries for different msgids pointing to the same article bytes, and a crafted peer can inject articles by manipulating the envelope msgid to skip dedup while putting fresh content in the body.
